TFT Set 14: Cyber City Update TFT 14. AD means attack damage. AP meants ability power. MR means magic resist. List of Champtions: 
 1. Alistar. Cost: 1 gold. Traits: Golden Ox, Bruiser. Passive: Reduce all incoming damage by 10/15/25 (scaling with AP). Ability: Deal 200/300/450 magic damage (scaling with AP) to the current target and Stun them for 2 seconds. 
 2. Annie. Cost: 4 gold. Traits: Golden Ox, A.M.P. Passive: None. Ability: Throw a fireball at the current target that deals 175/265/790 magic damage (scaling with AP) and mini-fireballs split between the target and 2 nearby enemies that deal 40/60/180 magic damage (scaling with AP) each. Every 4 casts, instead, summon Tibbers next to the current target, dealing 270/405/1215 magic damage (scaling AP) to enemies within 1 hex. 
 3. Aphelios. Cost: 4 gold. Traits: Golden Ox, Marksman. Passive: None. Ability: Fire a moon blast at the largest group of enemies that deals  physical damage (scaling AD & AP) to enemies within 2 hexes. Equip 4 Chakram, plus 1 more for each enemy hit by the blast, that last for 6 attacks and deal 0.07/0.07/0.2 bonus physical (scaling with AD) damage each. 
 4. Aurora. Cost: 5 gold. Traits: Anima Squad, Dynamo. Passive: None. Ability: On first cast, swap places with the left-most champion on your bench and continue fighting. That champion gains 0.5/1/10 Attack Speed (scaling AP). If the swapped champion dies, return to the board. Teleport to hit the most enemies in a line, dealing 80/175/1111 magic damage (scaling with AP) to each one, plus 500/900/7777 magic damage (scaling with AP) split between all enemies hit. Aurora cannot swap places with another Aurora. 
 5. Brand. Cost: 4 gold. Traits: Street Demon, Techie. Passive: None. Ability: Throw a paint bomb at the largest group of enemies within hexes, dealing 200/300/900 magic damage (scaling with AP) to enemies within 1 hex and 100/150/450 magic damage (scaling with AP) to the nearest 4 enemies. 
 6. Braum. Cost: 3 gold. Traits: Syndicate, Vanguard. Passive: None. Ability: Gain 450/475/500 Shield (scaling with AP & Health) for 4 seconds. When it breaks, deal 100/150/240 magic damage (scaling with AP)to the 3 closest enemies and Chill them for 3 seconds. Kingpin bonus: Gain 20/100 Armor and Magic Resist. Upgraded Kingpin bonus: Every 4/2 seconds, Braum's next attack deals 1 + 1 + 0.1 bonus magic damage (scaling with Armor & MR & Health). 
 7. Chogath. Cost: 4 gold. Traits: Boombots, Bruiser. Passive: None. Ability: Fire a disorienting sound blast in a cone, dealing 100/150/1500 + 0.03 magic damage (scaling with AP & Health). Gain max Health (scaling with AP & Health), get bigger, and increase the size of future sound blasts. 
 8. Darius. Cost: 2 gold. Traits: Syndicate, Bruiser. Passive: None. Ability: Heal 0.05 + 200/220/240 Health (scaling with AP & Health), then deal 2 physical damage (scaling with AD) and 0.2% Sunder enemies within 1 hex for 6 seconds. Kingpin bonus: Increase Ability range to 2 hexes. Damage reduced by 0.1% per hex away. Heal 0.02 + 50 Health (scaling with Health) for each enemy hit. Upgraded Kingpin bonus: Increase Ability range to 4 hexes. Damage reduced by 0.1% per hex away. Heal 0.02 + 50 (Health) Health for each enemy hit. 
 9. Dr. Mundo. Cost: 1 gold. Traits: Street Demon, Bruiser, slayer. Passive: Gain 0.3% more max Health from all sources. Ability: Flex, healing 0.02 + 75/115/175 Health (scaling with Health & AP), then deal 1.3 + 0.2 physical damage (scaling with Health & AP) to the current target. 
 10. Draven. Cost: 3 gold. Traits: Cypher, Rapidfire. Passive: None. Ability: Hurl two massive axes at the most enemies in a line, dealing 3.3/3.3/3.4 + 30/45/80 physical damage (scaling with AD & AP) before returning. Damage is reduced by 0.2% for each enemy hit. 
 11. Ekko. Cost: 2 gold. Traits: Street Demon, Strategist. Passive: None. Ability: Heal 280/340/425 Health (scaling with AP) and deal 180/270/410 magic damage (scaling with AP)to the current target. 
 12. Elise. Cost: 3 gold. Traits: Nitro, Dynamo. Passive: None. Ability: Fire 4 lasers at the current target and 4 more split between the nearest 2 enemies, each dealing 54/81/140 magic damage (scaling with AP) and reducing Magic Resist by 6 for the rest of combat. 
 13. Fiddlesticks. Cost: 3 gold. Traits: BoomBots, Techie. Passive: None. Ability: For 3 seconds, tether to the closest 3 enemies, dealing 240/360/575 magic damage (scaling with AP) per second split between them. Tethers apply 0.2% Shred and heal Fiddlesticks for 0.15% of the damage dealt. 
 14. Galio. Cost: 3 gold. Traits: Cypher, Bastion. Passive: None. Ability: Gain Durability (scaling with AP) for 3 seconds. Afterwards, heal 250/300/400 Health (scaling with AP) and send a whirlwind at the enemy within 3 hexes that dealt the most damage to Galio during that time. It deals 150/225/335 magic damage (scaling withAP) and Stuns for 1.5 seconds. 
 15. Garen. Cost: 5 gold. Traits: God of the Net. Passive: None. Ability: Gain 700/1000/5000 Shield (scaling with AP) for 2 seconds. Deal 6.5/6.5/30 physical damage (scaling with AD) to the current target and send a wave that deals 2.6/2.6/15 physical damage (scaling with AD) to enemies hit. If the wave hits 2 or fewer enemies, gain 50 Mana. 
 16. Gragas. Cost: 3 gold. Traits: Bruiser, Divinicorp. Passive: None. Ability: Heal 300/325/350 + 0.1 Health (scaling with Health & AP), then throw a cask at the largest group of enemies within 3 hexes, dealing 150/225/335 magic damage (scaling with AP) to enemies within 1 hex. 
 17. Graves. Cost: 2 gold. Traits: Golden Ox, Executioner. Passive: Attacks fire 5 projectiles in a cone that deal 0.35 physical damage (scaling with AD) each. Graves casts every 2 attacks. Ability: Dash next to the target and quickly fire 2 empowered shells that deal 6/9/16 + 0.4/0.4/0.45 physical damage (scaling with AD & AP) per projectile. 
 18. Illaoi. Cost: 2 gold. Traits: Anima Squad, Bastion. Passive: None. Ability: Heal 350/400/500 Health (scaling with AP). Deal 150/225/350 magic damage (scaling with AP) the current target and 60/90/140 (scaling with AP) to enemies within 1-hex. Reduce their Magic Resist by 15 for the rest of combat. 
 19. Jarvan IV. Cost: 3 gold. Traits: Golden Ox, Slayer, Vanguard. Passive: None. Ability: Strike the most enemies in a semi-circle, gaining 270/300/350 Shield (scaling with AP) for 4 seconds plus 30/50/80 (scaling with AP) per enemy hit. Deal 1.2 physical damage (scaling with AD) to enemies hit and reduce their Armor by 15/18/20 for the rest of combat. 
 20. Jax. Cost: 1 gold. Traits: Exotech, Bastion. Passive: None. Ability: Gain 350/425/525 Shield (scaling with AP) for 4 seconds and deal 110/165/250 magic damage (scaling with AP) to adjacent enemies. 
 21. Jhin. Cost: 2 gold. Traits: Exotech, Dynamo, Marksman. Passive: None. Ability: Fire a bouncing grenade that hits four enemies, dealing 1.44 physical damage (scaling with AD) and 0.2% Sundering them for 4.4 seconds (scaling with AP). The fourth bounce returns to the initial target and deals 3.84 physical damage (scaling with AD). 
 22. Jinx. Cost: 3 gold. Traits: Street Demon, Marksman. Passive: None. Ability: Fire rockets at random enemies within 2 hexes of the current target. Each rocket deals 1.4/1.4/1.5 physical damage (scaling with AD). Each cast fires an additional rocket. 
 23. Kindred. Cost: 1 gold. Traits: Nitro, Marksman, Rapidfire. Passive: None. Ability: Fire wolf at the current target, dealing 5.2 + 20/30/45 physical damage (scaling with AD). Overkill damage bounces to the nearest enemy. 
 24. Kobuko. Cost: 5 gold. Traits: Bruiser, Cyberboss. Passive: Attacks deal 90/135/314  bonus magic damage (scaling with AP). At 0.35/0.35/0.9% Health, gain 0.7/0.7/4 Shield (scaling with Health) decaying over 8 seconds, 1% Attack Speed, 0.2/0.2/1% Omnivamp, and 100 Mana. Ability: Briefly gain 0.6/0.6/0.99% Durability, then pick up a nearby enemy, knocking up all enemies within 1 hex for 1.5 seconds. Then, slam down, dealing 200/300/13370 magic damage (scaling with AP) to the target and 0.08/0.12/1 + 0.03/0.05/1 (scaling with AP) of the target's max Health as magic damage to all enemies hit. Cyberboss Upgrade: Knock up all enemies within 2 hexes for 1.5 seconds. 
 25. Kogmaw. Cost: 1 gold. Traits: BoomBots, Rapidfire. Passive: None. Ability: For the next 5 seconds, gain 0.5% Attack Speed and attacks deal 0.4 bonus physical damage (scaling with AD). 
 26. Leblanc. Cost: 2 gold. Traits: Strategist, Cypher. Passive: None. Ability: Send sigils, alternating between the current target and the next nearest enemy, each dealing 65/95/145 magic damage (scaling with AP). Every cast, send 1 more sigil. 
 27. Leona. Cost: 4 gold. Traits: Anima Squad, Vanguard. Passive: None. Ability: Gain Durability (scaling with AP) for 4 seconds. Deal 100/150/1200 magic damage (scaling with AP) to the largest clump of enemies within 2 hexes and Stun the center enemy for 2 seconds. Enemies damaged by this ability take 0.15/0.25/1.5 bonus magic damage (scaling with MR) from allies' attacks for 4/4/10 seconds. 
 28. Miss Fortune. Cost: 4 gold. Traits: Syndicate, Dynamo. Passive: None. Ability: Fire 8 waves of bullets towards the largest clump of enemies over 2 seconds. Enemies struck take 0.6/0.6/1.5 + 8/12/100 physical damage (scaling with AD) from the first bullet of each wave, and 0.25% less from other bullets in the same wave. Kingpin bonus: Fire 3 more waves. Upgraded Kingpin bonus: Bullets pierce enemies for 0.8% damage. 
 29. Mordekaiser. Cost: 3 gold. Traits: Techie, Bruiser, Exotech. Passive: None. Ability: Gain 475/525/700 Shield (scaling with AP) for 4 seconds. Slam the current target, dealing 200/300/500 magic damage (scaling with AP) in a 2-hex line and Stun all enemies hit for 1.25 seconds. 
 30. Morgana. Cost: 1 gold. Traits: Divinicorp, Dynamo. Passive: None. Active: Hack the target and the nearest non-hacked enemy, dealing 195/290/480 magic damage (scaling with AP) over 10 seconds. 
 31. Naafiri. Cost: 2 gold. Traits: Exotech, A.M.P. Passive: Gain 0.15 Omnivamp (scaling with AP). Abiility: Deal 2.65 physical damage (scaling with AD) to the current target. Then, summon packmates that deal 0.65/0.65/0.7 physical damage (scaling with AD) and Alphas that deal 1.65/1.65/1.75 physical damage (scaling with AD) to the current target. 
 32. Neeko. Cost: 4 gold. Traits: Street Demon, Strategist. Passive: None. Ability: Gain 280/300/1500 + 0.1 Shield (scaling with AP & Health) for 4 seconds and create an expanding zone that pops three times, each dealing 80/120/360 magic damage (scaling with AP) to enemies hit. The third pop Chills enemies for 3 seconds. 
 33. Nidalee. Cost: 1 gold. Traits: Nitro, A.M.P. Passive: None. Ability: Deal 210/315/475 magic damage (scaling with AP) to the current target and 80/120/180 magic damage (scaling with AP) to the nearest enemies. Heal 100/125/210 Health + 20/25/40 per enemy hit. 
 34. Poppy. Cost: 1 gold. Traits: Cyberboss, Bastion. Passive: None. Ability: Throw a buckler at the farthest enemy within 4 hexes, dealing 1.6/2.4/3.6 magic damage (scaling with Armor & AP) and magic damage to enemies within 1 hex. Cyberboss Upgrade: Gain 375/450/525 Shield (scaling with AP). 
 35. Renekton. Cost: 5 gold. Traits: Divinicorp, Overlord, Bastion. Passive: None. Ability: Deal 3/3/30 + 30/40/500 physical damage (scaling with AD & AP) to enemies within 2 hexes and Burn, and Wound them for 5 seconds. Gain 400/550/6000 max Health. First Cast: Enter frenzy mode where attacks strike twice, dealing total physical damage (scaling with AD) and can dash to new targets.Second Cast: Frenzy mode now strikes thrice, dealing total physical damage (scaling with AD). Cannot cast again. 
 36. Rengar. Cost: 3 gold. Traits: Street Demon, Executioner. Passive: None. Ability: Heal 160/200/250 Health (scaling with AP) and leap to the lowest Health enemy in hexes, dealing 2.5 physical damage (scaling with AD). Then, strike 2 times, each dealing 1.8 physical damage (scaling with AD). Each cast increases leap range by 1 hex. 
 37. Rhaast. Cost: 2 gold. Traits: Divinicorp, Vanguard. Passive: None. Ability: Knock the target into the air for 1.75 seconds. Over the duration, heal Health (scaling with AP & Health) and deal 4 physical damage (scaling with AD) to the target. 
 38. Samira. Cost: 5 gold. Traits: Street Demon, A.M.P. Passive: None. Ability: Dash towards the target and fire a volley of bullets over 2 seconds split between enemies within three hexes. Each bullet Shreds 4 Armor and deals 0.8/0.8/4 physical damage (scaling with AD), reduced by 0.2% per hex distance from Samira. When the volley ends, dash back to safety while dealing 5/5/25 physical damage (scaling with AD) to the current target. For the duration of the Ability, Samira is Unstoppable and has 0.25/0.25/1 Omnivamp (scaling with AP). 
 39. Sejuani. Cost: 4 gold. Traits: Exotech, Bastion. Passive: Gain 0.3% more Armor and Magic Resist from all sources. Active: Throw an EMP at the closest enemy that explodes after 2 seconds. It deals 120/180/1200 magic damage (scaling with AP) to enemies within 3 hexes and Stun them for 1.75/2/8 seconds. 
 40. Senna. Cost: 3 gold. Traits: Divinicorp, Slayer. Passive: Attacks deal 0.33 physical damage (scaling with AD) to enemies adjacent to the target. Ability: Fire a beam two hexes beyond the current target, dealing 4/4/4.2 + 20/30/45 physical damage (scaling with AD) to enemies hit. 
 41. Seraphine. Cost: 1 gold. Traits: Anima Squad, Techie. Passive: None. Ability: Fire a soundwave through the current target that deals 220/330/500 magic damage (scaling with AP), reduced by 0.4% for each enemy hit. 
 42. Shaco. Cost: 1 gold. Traits: Syndicate, Slayer. Passive: Gain 0.015% Attack Damage for each kill this game. Ability: Deal 3.4 + 40/60/90 physical damage (scaling with AD) to the current target. Kingpin bonus: Teleport behind the lowest Health enemy within 4 hexes and deal 0.5 bonus physical damage (scaling with AD). Upgraded Kingpin bonus: Teleport behind the lowest Health enemy within 4 hexes and deal 0.75 bonus physical damage (scaling with AD). If this kills, immediately cast again with 0.9% damage. 
 43. Shyvana. Cost: 2 gold. Traits: Nitro, Bastion, Techie. Passive: None. Ability: First cast - Every second for the rest of combat, heal 0.01 + 10/13/16 Health (scaling with AP & Health) and deal 18/27/40 + 0.01 magic damage (scaling with AP & Health) to adjacent enemies. Gain 200/250/300 max Health (scaling with AP) and 0.1% Damage Amp. 
 44. Skarner. Cost: 2 gold. Traits: Boombots, Vanguard. Passive: None. Ability: Gain 325/375/450 Shield (scaling with AP) for 3 seconds and dredge up a missile. When the Shield ends, hurl the missile at the group of most enemies within hexes, dealing magic damage (scaling with Armor) to the centermost enemy, and 0.5% of the damage to enemies adjacent to them. 
 45. Sylas. Cost: 1 gold. Traits: Anima Squad, Vanguard. Passive: None. Ability: Gain 150/200/250 max Health (scaling with AP) and deal 0.1 + 100/150/225 magic damage (scaling with AP & Health) to the current target. If they die, gain an additional 75/100/125 Health. 
 46. Twisted Fate. Cost: 2 gold. Traits: Syndicate, Rapidfire. Passive: Gain 3 Ability Power each Attack. Ability: Throw a card at the current target and next nearest target, dealing 160/240/375 magic damage (scaling with AP). Kingpin bonus: Throw a random special card at the current target that deals 280/420/650 magic damage (scaling with AP). Red card hits enemies in a 1-hex area. Blue card deals 0.5% of its damage as true damage. Rarely, Yellow card grants gold. Upgraded Kingpin bonus: Throw all three special cards at three nearby enemies. Red card hits enemies in a 1-hex area. Blue card deals 0.5% of its damage as true damage. Rarely, Yellow card grants gold. 
 47. Urgot. Cost: 5 gold. Traits: Boombots, Executioner. Passive: None. Ability: For 5/5/60 seconds, gain 1.25/1.25/5% Attack Speed and lock-on to the lowest percent Health enemy within hexes. Attacks also fire 3 rockets, each dealing 1/1/2 + 10/15/100 total physical damage (scaling with AD). Each cast, the first time a locked-on enemy falls beneath 0.15/0.15/0.95% Health, reel them in, execute them, and grind them into parts. 
 48. Varus. Cost: 3 gold. Traits: Exotech, Executioner. Passive: None. Ability: Fire a chain that deals 200/300/480 magic damage (scaling with AP) and Stuns for 1 seconds. The chain links to the 3 closest enemies, dealing 100/150/240 magic damage (scaling with AP) to each. 
 49. Vayne. Cost: 2 gold. Traits: Anima Squad, Slayer. Passive: None. Ability: Rapidly fire 3 attacks. The first two deal 0.5 bonus true damage (scaling with AD), and the final attack deals 1.5 + 10/15/25 bonus true damage (scaling with AD). 
 50. Veigar. Cost: 2 gold. Traits: Cyberboss. Techie. Passive: None. Ability: Deal 300/400/540 magic damage (scaling with AP) to the current target and adjacent enemies. Cyberboss Bonus: If Veigar is the same star level as the target, deal 0.2% true damage. If Veigar is a higher star level, deal 0.33% true damage. 
 51. Vex. Cost: 4 gold. Traits: Divinicorp, Executioner. Passive: Gain 0.15% Omnivamp. 0.8% of overhealing from Retribution's damage is converted to bonus true damage to its primary target. Ability: Send a shadow to the target, dealing 100/150/450 magic damage (scaling with AP) to all enemies it passes through. The shadow then explodes, dealing 220/330/900 magic damage (scaling with AP) to the target and 100/150/450 (scaling with AP) to enemies within 1 hex. 
 52. Vi. Cost: 1 gold. Traits: Cypher, Vanguard. Passive: None. Ability: Gain Shield (scaling with AP & Health) that rapidly decays over 4 seconds. Vi's next attack deals 5 physical damage (scaling with AD). 
 53. Viego. Cost: 5 gold. Traits: Golden Ox, Soul Killer, Techie. Passive: When units die, absorb their soul and heal 0.06 Health (scaling with Health). Ability: Jump to the largest clump of enemies within 2 hexes, dealing 240/360/4000 magic damage (scaling with AP) to adjacent enemies and 120/180/4000 magic damage (scaling with AP) to other enemies within 2 hexes. 20% Shred all enemies hit for 4 seconds. 
 54. Xayah. Cost: 4 gold. Traits: Anima Squad, Marksman. Passive: None. Ability: Impale 6 feathers into the current target that each deal 1.6/1.6/4 + 20/30/200 physical damage (scaling with AD). When the target dies, the feathers seek out nearby enemies within 2-hexes, each dealing 0.33/0.33/1 physical damage (scaling with AD). 
 55. Yuumi. Cost: 3 gold. Traits: A.M.P., Strategist, Anima Squad. Passive: Gain Mana every second. Ability: Launch a magic missile at the current target that bounces to the nearest enemy. Deal 100/150/240 magic damage (scaling with AP) to the current target and 50/75/120 (scaling with AP) to the other, marking both of them. If they're already marked, deal 2% damage. 
 56. Zac. Cost: 5 gold. Traits: Virus. Passive: At 0.1% Health, split into two copies with 0.5% Health. Ability: Bounce 3 times on nearby enemies. Each bounce deals 130/195/1000 + 0.08/0.08/0.5 magic damage (scaling with AP & Health), Stuns for 1 second, and heals Zac 80/100/2000 Health (scaling with AP). 
 57. Zed. Cost: 4 gold. Traits: Cypher, Slayer. Passive: None. Ability: Throw a shuriken at the furthest unmarked enemy that deals 60/90/400 magic damage (scaling with AP) and marks them. Then become untargetable, teleport to them, and summon shadows on every other marked enemy. Deal 2.5/2.5/5 physical damage (scaling with AD) to adjcent enemies, while shadows deal 1.5/1.5/2.75 physical damage (scaling with AD) to adjacent enemies. 
 58. Zeri. Cost: 4 gold. Traits: Exotech, Rapidfire. Passive: None. Ability: Dash to a nearby location so quickly an untargetable echo lingers. The echo Attacks (scaling with AD & AS) as if it were Zeri, but deals 0.5/0.5/1.2% damage. Echoes last a few seconds (scaling with AP), and disappear when Zeri dies. 
 59. Ziggs. Cost: 4 gold. Traits: Strategist, Cyberboss. Passive: None. Ability: Throw a bomb that hits the most enemies in a + shape within Attack Range, dealing 275/415/1200 magic damage (scaling with AP). Cyberboss Upgrade: Throw a bomb that hits the most enemies in a whole row and column within Attack Range, dealing 275/415/1200 magic damage (scaling with AP) to enemies within 1 hex of the center and 100/150/450 magic damage (scaling with AP) to enemies further away.

Ability: Send a large vine towards the current target, Stunning them for 1 second and dealing 250/375/585 magic damage (scaling with AP).
